Order 
01.

This is the applicant's first application filed under Section 482 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita , 2023/ Section 438 of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973 for grant of anticipatory bail, as he is apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No.264/2016 registered at Police Station Rajendra Nagar, District Indore (MP) for offence punishable under Sections 420, 34, 467, 468 and 471 of IPC.
02.

Admittedly, the FIR in the present case against the applicant has been lodged on 08.04.2016 under Sections 420 and 34 of the IPC in which he was already granted bail by the trial Court itself,
however, the investigation continued, and subsequently Sections 467, 468 and 471 have also been added, however, the chargesheet has still not been filed.

03. Counsel for the applicant has submitted that in such circumstances when a dispute is already going on between the parties in respect of the land, NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-IND:54 2 MCRC-51706-2025 which the applicant has sold after the rejection of mutation application of the complainant, his custodial interrogation would not be necessary.
04.

Counsel for the respondent/State has opposed the prayer and it is submitted that despite issuance of notice, the applicant has not appeared in the Police Station, as his signatures were required for the purpose of handwriting expert's report.

05. Having considered the rival submissions and perusal of the case- diary and taking note of the fact that the FIR was lodged way back in the year 2016 and the applicant was also granted bail, and the investigation has been kept pending by the prosecution and there is nothing on record to suggest that the applicant has misused the liberty extended to him, and otherwise also, it is apparent that the case relates to a land dispute between the parties.
In such circumstances, this Court is of the considered opinion that the custodial interrogation of the applicant is not necessary in the present case.
06. Accordingly, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, the application filed by the present applicant is allowed.

It is directed that in the event of arrest, applicant-Mahesh shall be released on bail, upon his executing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (rupees twenty five thousand only) and furnishing separate solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer (Investigating Officer)/ concerned trial court.
07.
The applicant shall make himself available for interrogation by a Police Officer, as and when required.
He shall further abide by the other NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-IND:54 3 MCRC-51706-2025 conditions enumerated in Sub Section (2) of Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.
08. Accordingly, M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.
